subject.title: fix(telegram): route poll answers into sessions

question: Should an authorized non-anonymous Telegram `poll_answer` be treated as a session-triggering agent event, including configured forum-topic routing and subsequent vote changes?
rationale: The existing poll-send capability does not itself establish the permanent product contract for turning every public poll update into agent work; this choice affects user-visible interaction semantics and session activity.

options.title: Adopt session-event routing
options.body: Accept poll votes as authorized session events and require exact-head direct and forum-topic proof before merge.

options.title: Keep polls display-only
options.body: Reject inbound vote routing and document that Telegram polls do not create actionable agent events.

options.title: Define narrower semantics
options.body: Specify a constrained contract, such as one-shot approval handling or explicit poll opt-in, before requesting a narrower implementation.

recommendation.title: Adopt session-event routing
recommendation.body: Accept poll votes as authorized session events and require exact-head direct and forum-topic proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged poll-send work is the closest available feature-history signal for the affected Telegram boundary.
